event_chain.summary: Cyberattack forces systems offline, disrupting orders and deliveries

summary: On October 21, 2026 Germany-based equipment supplier TAKKT disclosed a cyberattack affecting its Foodservices division in North America (based in Harrison, Ohio, including Hubert Company and Central Restaurant Products) and systems in its Industrial & Packaging division in Europe. TAKKT took affected IT systems offline, and order processing, customer service and deliveries were significantly restricted. It had not confirmed ransomware or data theft and was working with outside cybersecurity and forensic specialists.
